news.title: ProjectForge 9.0: a new frontend, Wicket retired, all libraries up to date
news.text: ProjectForge 9.0 is a major update. The classic Wicket user interface was replaced by **projectforge-next**, a new frontend built with Next.js and React, and all libraries were brought up to date. It also brings a problem dashboard for operations, many new charts with key figures, robust interfaces to external systems, e-invoicing and an identity provider integration. The development builds leading up to it are listed in the changelog as 8.2 snapshots.
highlights: **New frontend projectforge-next:** all pages migrated, including calendar, time sheets, order book, invoices, structure tree, access rights, monthly report, liquidity planning and administration. The classic Wicket module has been removed.

**Problem dashboard:** log events are classified and aggregated into problems with a persistent status, with links into the log viewer, a JSON export for an AI-assisted analysis and prioritized error digest mails instead of one mail per error.

**Charts and key figures:** order statistics with budget scenario, contribution margins, forecast, invoicing and net sum charts with a year-earlier comparison, invoicing quota and error figures in the system statistics.

**Robust interfaces:** timeouts, connection pools, bounded sync threads and sync statistics for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS, Sipgate and the gateway; an unreachable system fails fast instead of blocking, failing calendar subscriptions are retried with a growing interval.
**E-invoicing:** XRechnung and ZUGFeRD export of outgoing invoices, PEPPOL validation, cancellation invoices and an e-invoice checker.
**Identity provider:** synchronization of users, groups and passwords with Authentik or Keycloak (module projectforge-idp).
**Finance:** recurring liquidity entries, DATEV import of incoming invoices, salary import, currency conversion with online exchange rates.
**Technology:** Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Hibernate Search 8.4, Tomcat 11, Kotlin 2.3, Next.js 16, React 19, TanStack Table.

items: Project list: columns for the last time sheet, the last order date and the last activity (the later of both), sortable, to spot projects that have probably ended.

Calendar: book several days at once, e.g. a vacation or an absence booked on behalf of a colleague; weekends, holidays and already booked days are skipped, half working days are booked pro rata, templates, recent time sheets and the booked user's vacations can be taken over (vacation task and cost unit configurable via projectforge.timesheet.vacation.taskId/kost2).

Sipgate interface implemented for synchronization of address.
Calendar view improved.
Excel-Export of vacations for all employees, teams and colleagues.
Birthdaybutler for monthly birthday list.
Export of timesheets as xlsx.
Attachments to books added.
lots of minor improvements.
several bugs fixed.
Docker container available for arm64 as well as for amd64 (Linux and macOS X).
Persistence layer completely refactored, MGC removed and replaced by Spring Data JPA.
technical debt reduced.
New major versions: Java 17, Spring 6.1.15, Hibernate 6.6.3, Hibernate search 7.2.1, javax -> jakarta, React/Router, Wicket 10.2, ...
The main calendar refactored (colors, functionalities, more customizable etc.)
Datatransfer-Plugin: Notification improved

items.title: Vacations
items: support now multiple substitutions.
Shows now conflicts
History of changes improved.
2FA-requests preserve now input fields.
lots of minor improvements.
Menu customization in classical version.
Yubikey now also supported in other browsers: Chrome, Edge etc.
several bugs fixed.
User/group administration in new version.
Some issues from last security pen test implemented.
New versions: Java 15, Spring, React/Router, Wicket
Separation of db table user and passwords.

releases.title: ProjectForge 7.4 released
intro: 2FA (SMS, Authenticator, Fido2) now fully supported. Multi-upload with progress bars for data-transfer-areas.

items: 2FA (use SMS, mail, Authenticator app or Webauthn/Fido2 as 2nd factor for much more security.)
Password reset for users implemented (it's only usable for users with configured 2FA / mail isn't supported for password reset due to security reasons).
Scripts may be executed by users/groups without special rights (sudo functionality is supported). You may configure reports e. g. for project managers including financial data.
mass update and selection of invoices for e. g. bank transfers etc.

items.title: Datatransfer:
items: Multiple upload with progress bars implemented. Very nice.
Multi selection of files for deletion and download.
Audit on areas added (for seeing what happened)
E-mail notifications improved: files being deleted and audit log on areas.
CSRF-Handling: if session token was changed, the user is able to simply reload the page for continuing.
mass update functionality refactored and improved.
pagination for result lists of new UI introduced.
Several minor bugfixes
Password reset for users: Admins may enter cell numbers of users to enable password for users without any configured 2FA.

items.title: 2FA is now fully supported. You may configure:
items: 2FA after login (expires after x days after if stay-logged-in is used)
2FA expiry time (from 1 minute to 90 days) for special usage (e. g. user administration, password changing, financial stuff etc.)

releases.title: ProjectForge 7.3 released
intro: Data transfer combined with Merlin, scripting improved, 2FA introduced.

items: Combination of DataTransfer and Merlin: Serial PDFs/Words may be automatically generated and sent to the personal boxes of the users/employees.
Scripting: example-scripts, include supported, new source editor supporting Groovy and Kotlin.
Scripting functionalities improved.
Data protections improvements.
Several minor bugfixes
Ssh public key is also visible for non-admins.
2FA introduced (will be improved soon).

releases.title: ProjectForge 7.2 released
intro: Word templating (Merlin), log viewer, encryption in data transfer, privacy features.

items: Word-Templating (Merlin): Word templating for letters, information, contracts etc. with serial execution including variables, if-else-expressions etc. inside docx (like Velocity-Scripting-engine). All users/emloyees may receive letters/contracts etc. (as Word and/or PDF-files) in their personal boxes via serial execution. Example template files included for a quick start.
Log viewer added (for admins as well as for users for tracking own activity for mass updates of time-sheets, usage of Merlin or Datev-imports)
Gender for users added: Used by Merlin (word templating) for creation of personalized letters, contracts etc.
DataTransfer-Plugin: encryption added
Exporting SEPA-cash transfers improved: special characters unsupported by banking software will be replaced/removed.
Features for deleting data such as addresses, employee, vacataion data etc. implemented due to privacy restrictions in the EU. The deletion includes also history entries.
Several minor bugfixes
Search for deleted entries (addresses etc.) fixed.
Search in history entries (keywords, users) fixed.
No restart after first installation required anymore.
During Shutdown some temporarily created directories (tomcat.* and projectforge-application*) will be deleted automatically.
using char[] instead of String for passwords.

releases.title: ProjectForge 7.1.2 released
intro: Security issues of pentests, DataTransfer improved.

items: The DataTransfer tool is improved: download area in one zip, more options for external users
Security fixes from a penetration test.
Several minor bugfixes
Several minor improvements (order book etc.)
You can download the binaries from [Docker hub](https://hub.docker.com/r/micromata/projectforge)

releases.title: ProjectForge 7.1.1 released
intro: DataTransfer supports now personal boxes for one to one exchange of files. Docker improved. Minor fixes and improvements.

items: Data transfer: Personal box of every user for fast exchange of large files one to one.
Docker improved.
Update of all JavaScript libs (React etc.)
checksums for all files in data transfer as well as nightly run of sanity job.
CardDAV support improved (cell phone numbers)
Test data in test systems: no more unique constraint violations anymore on new test systems.
Support of Java 13+.
Major updates of nearly all libraries.
Multi tenancy removed.

releases.title: 🚀 ProjectForge 7.0 released
intro: **Major Release:** This version contains a lot of cool stuff: new front-end, data transfer tool, docker support.

items: New front-end
Data transfer tool for sharing files with other user's and external customers
New plugin: skill matrix for sharing knowledge.
Tons of new functionalities and improvements.
Available as Docker images for fastest installation ever.
Setup wizard for easy setup.
New front-end works with React.
Over 20% of the code is now developed with Kotlin.
Full Rest support for most functionality for other clients (such as a smartphone app).
